item.title: Correction · 1180 Fourth Street: The record's summary and map notes named Kennerly Architecture & Planning as lead designer; Mithun's project page shows Mithun (formerly WRT/Solomon E.T.C.) as architect, Kennerly as associate design architect and Full Circle Architects as associate architect. The notes said the building fills a full city block and is 216,000 sq ft; Mithun gives 217,620 sf on 1.4 acres at Fourth and Channel, so the block claim is withdrawn. The completion year is explained (Mithun 2014; DBI permit completed 2015-04-02; Assessor 2015). 'Very-low-income' was removed from the summary because only 'low-income' is sourced, and Mithun was added as a source. The Wikimedia aerial's credit now names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the NAIP credit names the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, which the data.gov record names as NAIP's administrator. The May 6, 2015 opening celebration rests on a Mercy Housing page that now returns 404 and is listed among the record's open questions.
